# aged whisky

aged whisky is a minimalist dark theme that removes the app borders, rounds image corners, restyles links and decorates headings in reading mode. Reading mode also narrows the editor to around 550 pixels for a shorter line length. The recorded description says to use it with a left sidebar and records the theme as dark mode only.

![aged whisky screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/incantatem2/Obsidian-aged-whisky/HEAD/images/aged-whisky-thumbnail.jpg)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "aged whisky"
    author: "incantatem2"
    repo:   "incantatem2/Obsidian-aged-whisky"
    slug:   "aged-whisky"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/aged-whisky"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/incantatem2/Obsidian-aged-whisky"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/incantatem2/Obsidian-aged-whisky/HEAD/images/aged-whisky-thumbnail.jpg"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply a minimalist dark theme with no app borders, rounded image corners, styled links, and elegant reading-mode headings. Narrow the editor to ~550px in reading mode for comfortable line length. Use with a left sidebar; dark-mode only."
}
```
